headline: Russia Launches 323 Drones at Ukraine; Hormuz Tanker Ablaze
subheadline: Ukrainian air defenses downed 310 drones while 10 struck targets; IRGC commander Vahidi denied authorizing Hormuz attacks on commercial vessels.
lede: Russian forces launched 323 drones across Ukraine on September 13, with air defenses intercepting 310 but 10 reaching targets including critical infrastructure. Ukrainian forces struck the Slavynsk-EKO oil refinery in Volgograd damaging chemical processing equipment while Russian drones hit a fuel depot near the Polish border. In the Middle East, IRGC attacks on commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz ignited a diplomatic crisis as President Pezeshkian demanded accountability from IRGC commander Vahidi who denied authorization. Southern Saudi cities including Khamis Mushait, Abha, Jizan, and Najran faced repeated drone and missile strikes while Lebanon endured 12 air strikes and 92 drone sightings in a single day.

sections.title: Russia Unleashes Record 323-Drone Assault
sections.body: Russian forces launched 323 drones between 06:30 and 18:00 on September 13, including 14 reactive variants, with Ukrainian air defenses downing 310. Ten drones penetrated defenses to strike targets across Ukraine. Ukrainian forces simultaneously damaged the Slavynsk-EKO oil refinery in Volgograd, hitting key chemical processing equipment. Russian drones also struck a fuel depot in Volyn approximately two kilometers from the Polish border, while multiple reactive drones launched from Kharkiv region tracked toward Kyiv and Chernihiv.

sections.title: IRGC Hormuz Attacks Spark Iranian Crisis
sections.body: Iran's President Pezeshkian publicly demanded accountability from IRGC commander Vahidi after IRGC forces attacked commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz early Tir, setting an LNG tanker ablaze and damaging other vessels. Vahidi denied authorizing the operation and stated neither NECSA nor SNSC were informed. Southern Saudi Arabia faced repeated drone and missile strikes placing Khamis Mushait, Abha, Jizan, and Najran on alert, with civil defense reporting cycles of danger followed by new strikes. Lebanon sustained 12 air strikes across Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Kafr Tebnit, Dabbesha, Al-Qantara, Zouqar East, Zibqin, Hariq, and Al-Mansouri, alongside 22 artillery shells and 92 drone sightings.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous escalation across both theaters suggests coordinated pressure campaigns: Russia's largest drone barrage to date aims to overwhelm Ukrainian air defenses while striking energy infrastructure deep in Russian territory and near NATO borders. In the Middle East, the Hormuz attacks expose fractures between Iran's civilian leadership and IRGC, while Saudi Arabia absorbs sustained asymmetric attacks and Israel formalizes a security zone in Lebanon after destroying a Hezbollah underground compound at Rades Ali Taher. The postponement of the Gulf foreign ministers meeting by Iran and Oman signals regional diplomatic paralysis amid rising maritime threats.
